options.content: Strategy portfolio from ControllerDiagnostics.state (virtual wallet when ledger_source=virtual, otherwise exchange account). Physical exchange balances are in physical_state when virtual mode is active. Exchange-account REST snapshots remain on 07A Exchange Accounts.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT e.ts AS "time", 'strategy_local_inventory' AS metric,
       CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['state','local_inventory'], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['state','local_inventory'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END AS value
FROM mm_events e
WHERE e.topic = ANY (SELECT 'strategy:diagnostics:' || id FROM unnest(ARRAY[${actor_id:sqlstring}]::text[]) AS id)
  AND e.event_type = 'ControllerDiagnostics'
  AND e.exchange = ANY(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND e.symbol = ANY(ARRAY[${symbol:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND e.actor_id = ANY(ARRAY[${actor_id:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
  AND e.payload #>> ARRAY['state','local_inventory'] IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL

WITH state_rows AS (
  SELECT e.ts AS "time",
         COALESCE(CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['state','local_quote_wallet','total'], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['state','local_quote_wallet','total'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END, CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['state','local_cash'], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['state','local_cash'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE 0.0
END) AS local_cash,
         COALESCE(CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['state','global_quote_wallet','total'], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['state','global_quote_wallet','total'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END, CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['state','global_cash'], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['state','global_cash'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE 0.0
END) AS global_cash,
         COALESCE(CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['state','local_base_wallet','total'], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['state','local_base_wallet','total'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END, CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['state','local_inventory'], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['state','local_inventory'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE 0.0
END) AS local_inventory,
         COALESCE(CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['state','global_base_wallet','total'], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['state','global_base_wallet','total'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END, CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['state','global_inventory'], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['state','global_inventory'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE 0.0
END) AS global_inventory,
         COALESCE(NULLIF(CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['optimizer','config','reference_price'], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['optimizer','config','reference_price'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END, 0.0), NULLIF(CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['state','global_sell_vwap'], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['state','global_sell_vwap'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END, 0.0), NULLIF(CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['state','local_sell_vwap'], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['state','local_sell_vwap'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END, 0.0), NULLIF(CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['state','mid'], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['state','mid'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END, 0.0)) AS reference_vwap,
         (CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['state','local_wealth'], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['state','local_wealth'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END + COALESCE(CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['state','global_wealth'], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['state','global_wealth'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END, 0.0)) AS reported_wealth
  FROM mm_events e
  WHERE e.topic = ANY (SELECT 'strategy:diagnostics:' || id FROM unnest(ARRAY[${actor_id:sqlstring}]::text[]) AS id)
  AND e.event_type = 'ControllerDiagnostics'
  AND e.exchange = ANY(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND e.symbol = ANY(ARRAY[${symbol:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND e.actor_id = ANY(ARRAY[${actor_id:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
)
SELECT "time", 'total_cash' AS metric,
       (local_cash + global_cash) AS value
FROM state_rows
UNION ALL
SELECT "time", 'total_inventory_value',
       CASE
         WHEN reference_vwap IS NOT NULL THEN (local_inventory + global_inventory) * reference_vwap
         WHEN reported_wealth IS NOT NULL THEN reported_wealth - local_cash - global_cash
         ELSE NULL
       END AS value
FROM state_rows
UNION ALL
SELECT "time", 'total_wealth',
       COALESCE(reported_wealth, (local_cash + global_cash + (local_inventory + global_inventory) * COALESCE(reference_vwap, 0.0))) AS value
FROM state_rows
ORDER BY 1

  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['optimizer','config','reference_price'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END, 0.0), NULLIF(CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['state','mid'], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['state','mid'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END, 0.0)) AS mark_price
  FROM mm_events e
  WHERE e.topic = ANY (SELECT 'strategy:diagnostics:' || id FROM unnest(ARRAY[${actor_id:sqlstring}]::text[]) AS id)
  AND e.event_type = 'ControllerDiagnostics'
  AND e.exchange = ANY(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND e.symbol = ANY(ARRAY[${symbol:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND e.actor_id = ANY(ARRAY[${actor_id:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
)
SELECT "time", 'local_cash' AS metric,
       cash AS value
FROM state_rows
UNION ALL
SELECT "time", 'local_inventory_value',
       CASE
         WHEN mark_price IS NOT NULL THEN inventory * mark_price
         WHEN reported_wealth IS NOT NULL THEN reported_wealth - cash
         ELSE NULL
       END AS value
FROM state_rows
UNION ALL
SELECT "time", 'local_wealth',
       COALESCE(reported_wealth, cash + inventory * COALESCE(mark_price, 0.0)) AS value
FROM state_rows
ORDER BY 1

list.definition:
SELECT exchange
FROM (
  SELECT exchange, max(latest_ts) AS latest_ts
  FROM (
  SELECT exchange, updated_at AS latest_ts
  FROM registry_exchanges
  WHERE status = 'active'
    AND exchange IS NOT NULL
    AND exchange <> ''
  ) sources
  WHERE exchange IS NOT NULL AND CAST(exchange AS text) <> ''
  GROUP BY exchange
) ranked
ORDER BY latest_ts DESC
